description: This file declares network-related functions and structures for the server, including socket management and event registration.

methods.name: network_accept_tcp_nagle_disable
methods.description: Disables TCP Nagle’s algorithm on the given socket descriptor.

methods.name: network_init
methods.description: Initializes network components for the server.

methods.name: network_close
methods.description: Closes network resources associated with the server.

methods.name: network_register_fdevents
methods.description: Registers file descriptor events for network activity.

methods.name: network_unregister_sock
methods.description: Unregisters a server socket from event polling.

methods.name: network_socket_activation_to_env
methods.description: Activates sockets and sets relevant environment variables.
